aap-share-books-2021.title: How to Share Books with Children 2 and 3 Years Old
aap-share-books-2021.scope_note: Age-specific shared reading and conversations. Not research measuring outcomes of these original audio stories.

zero3-read-early.title: Read Early and Often
relevant_sections: Reading with children approaching age three
Repetition and anticipation of familiar stories
zero3-read-early.scope_note: Discusses shared reading, repeating and predicting familiar stories; no controlled assessment of serialized TTS bedtime fiction.

cdc-three-milestones.title: Milestones by 3 Years
cdc-three-milestones.author_or_publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc-three-milestones.scope_note: Population guidance; not an age-three comprehension requirement or individual assessment tool for this story.

naeyc-open-questions-2024.title: Message in a Backpack: Asking Questions to Stretch Your Child's Thinking
naeyc-open-questions-2024.author_or_publisher: Janis Strasser, National Association for the Education of Young Children
relevant_sections: Ask open-ended questions to spark conversations
Questions to ask after reading a bedtime story
naeyc-open-questions-2024.scope_note: Optional prompts and family discussion. Does not evaluate Willow Bend or recommend interrogating a child when sleepy.

aap-social-preschool-2024.title: Social Development in Preschoolers: Learning How to Share & Cooperate
aap-social-preschool-2024.scope_note: Discusses emerging preschool friendships and adult help; not evidence that a fictional hedgehog story increases empathy.

harvard-ef-guide-2014.title: Activities Guide: Enhancing and Practicing Executive Function Skills with Children from Infancy to Adolescence
harvard-ef-guide-2014.author_or_publisher: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
harvard-ef-guide-2014.scope_note: Guidance on supported playful activities. Does not report an experimental test of tilted lanterns or TTS narratives.

ucar-sunshine-shadows.title: Sunshine and Shadows
relevant_sections: Why is a student's shadow long sometimes and short at other times?
ucar-sunshine-shadows.scope_note: Explains shadow formation and changes in shadow length with solar angle. Does not evaluate a preschool fiction story or its developmental effects.

nps-natural-sounds-education.title: Education Resources — Natural Sounds
nps-natural-sounds-education.author_or_publisher: U.S. National Park Service, Natural Sounds and Night Skies Division
nps-natural-sounds-education.scope_note: Educational listening and soundscape activities. It does not establish benefits from the fictional listening book, this audio story, or any age-three treatment.

mn-dnr-frog-calls.title: Frog & Toad Opera
relevant_sections: Other calls produced by toads and frogs
mn-dnr-frog-calls.scope_note: Real frogs produce several types of species-dependent calls. Todd the talking frog, yellow boots, and his invented bup sound are fictional.

aap-power-of-play-2018.title: The Power of Play: A Pediatric Role in Enhancing Development in Young Children
aap-power-of-play-2018.author_or_publisher: Michael Yogman, Andrew Garner, Jeffrey Hutchinson, Kathy Hirsh-Pasek, Roberta Michnick Golinkoff; American Academy of Pediatrics
relevant_sections: Social or Pretend Play Alone or With Others
aap-power-of-play-2018.scope_note: Clinical report (reaffirmed January 2025) synthesizing developmental play research. Does not test this fictional story series or listening outcomes; do not transfer broad findings about active play into specific claims about passive TTS listening.

umn-radishes-2024.title: Growing radishes in home gardens
umn-radishes-2024.author_or_publisher: Marissa Schuh and Jill MacKenzie, University of Minnesota Extension
relevant_sections: How to keep your radishes healthy and productive
umn-radishes-2024.scope_note: Reviewed 2024. Describes suitable outdoor planting, radish seedling emergence within ten days, cotyledons, and moisture needs. Does not prove that the fictional garden develops exactly this way or confer developmental gains on listeners.

umn-seed-starting-2026.title: Starting seeds indoors
umn-seed-starting-2026.scope_note: Reviewed 2026. Specifically covers indoor seed starts; used for general principles of labels, moisture, light and imperfect germination, not for site-specific outdoor planting advice. Outdoor radish claims use the separate radish source.

nasa-moon-phases.title: Moon Phases
nasa-moon-phases.scope_note: Explains reflected sunlight and changing apparent phases across roughly 29.5 days, with crescent, quarter, gibbous and full visibility times. Supports basic astronomy only, not a claim of improved science learning or sleep from story listening.

nasa-moon-water-reflection.title: CYGNSS — Helping to Predict Hurricane Strength
nasa-moon-water-reflection.author_or_publisher: NASA Earth Science, Notes from the Field
relevant_sections: How Can You Measure Winds From Space?
analogy of a full moon reflected in a lake
nasa-moon-water-reflection.scope_note: NASA uses Moon reflected in flat versus rippled lake water to explain reflection patterns. The story applies the general optics to a half-lit Moon reflection; not a measured preschool activity.

nasa-moon-facts.title: Moon Facts
nasa-moon-facts.scope_note: Describes Moon as a distant body, its orbit and change of phases. Todd's reed occlusion example uses elementary line-of-sight reasoning written for the story, not an experiment reported by NASA.

zerotothree-coping-with-change-2009.title: Coping with Change
relevant_sections: Children vary in how they cope with change
zerotothree-coping-with-change-2009.scope_note: Discusses individual differences in responses to transitions, familiar objects and adult support. Neither a trial of these stories nor evidence that Sue's fictional move predicts real children's reactions.

naeyc-social-emotional-home.title: Building Social and Emotional Skills at Home
naeyc-social-emotional-home.author_or_publisher: National Association for the Education of Young Children (NAEYC), adapted from Message in a Backpack
naeyc-social-emotional-home.scope_note: Suggests respecting personal toy preferences in advance of peer play and optional story discussions. Does not demonstrate benefits of these TTS fiction scripts.

naeyc-caring-community-dap.title: DAP: Creating a Caring, Equitable Community of Learners
naeyc-caring-community-dap.author_or_publisher: National Association for the Education of Young Children (NAEYC)
relevant_sections: A. Each member of the community is valued
C. Each member of the community respects and is accountable
naeyc-caring-community-dap.scope_note: Guidance for educators and communities, not a clinical test of the fictional dialogue, an at-home listening prescription, or proof of particular outcomes.
